PDF rendering of the Master List slip for [[Darth Vader, More Machine Than Man (Errata 4)]], front face. It prints the PC-E4 game text (official text as of 27 April 2013), word for word the forum errata text of [[Darth Vader, More Machine Than Man (Errata)]] (PC-E1).

== References ==
[https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)], PDF page 7. Wiki copy: [[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf]].

Rendered at 300 dpi from the wiki copy and cropped to the slip (11 November 2026, Batch S1).
